english_paragraphs: Name two addresses and a London cabbie will rattle off the quickest route. That prowess is hard-won. To earn a licence, aspiring drivers must conquer "the Knowledge", an arduous examination on about 25,000 streets within six miles of Charing Cross. Hopefuls typically spend three to four years committing this labyrinth to memory, and only about half qualify.

A study published in PNAS in April 2000 scanned 16 male cabbies and 50 other men. The hippocampus is a seahorse-shaped structure vital to memory and navigation. In the cabbies, its rear, or posterior, portion was larger than in the other men, and its front, or anterior, portion smaller. Longer service went with a larger rear portion.

Yet the link left the cause uncertain. Perhaps an innate flair for spatial tasks lured people to the occupation, or perhaps stressful driving was the culprit. A December 2006 study dispelled the second notion: cabbies had more rear grey matter, the tissue dense with nerve cells, than bus drivers, confined to predetermined routes, of equivalent experience and stress.

A December 2011 longitudinal study tackled the first, scanning 79 trainees and 31 non-trainees at enrolment and three to four years later. Their brains began alike. Only the 39 who qualified exhibited an expansion of rear grey matter, so the sequence suggests learning preceded the enlargement.

The gain appeared to entail a trade-off: qualified drivers trailed the non-trainees on one test of recalling an intricate figure. The cohorts were small and exclusively male, yet the studies imply the healthy adult brain can remodel itself through intensive learning. Every street learned, it seems, occupied room once claimed by something else.
chinese_paragraphs: 只要说出两个地址，伦敦出租车司机就能迅速报出最快的路线。这份本领来之不易。为了取得执照，准司机必须攻克一项叫作“知识大考”的艰难考试，熟记距查令十字六英里以内约2.5万条街道。备考者通常花三到四年把这座街道迷宫牢记于心，最终只有约一半能够合格。
2000年4月发表于《美国国家科学院院刊》的一项研究，扫描了16名男性出租车司机和50名其他男性的大脑。海马体形似海马，对记忆和认路至关重要。与其他男性相比，出租车司机海马体的后部更大，前部则更小。从业时间越长，后部也越大。
然而，这种关联并不能确定原因。也许是天生擅长空间任务的人更容易被这个职业吸引，也许是紧张的驾驶工作造成了差异。2006年12月的一项研究排除了后一种解释：与驾驶经验、压力水平相当的公交司机相比，出租车司机海马体后部的灰质仍然更多。灰质是一种密布神经细胞的组织，而公交司机的行驶路线是预先固定的。
2011年12月的一项纵向研究开始检验前一种解释。研究者在79名学员报名时，以及三到四年后，分别扫描了他们和31名未参训者的大脑。各组起初的大脑状况相似，只有最终通过考试的39名学员，出现了海马体后部灰质增加。这一先后顺序提示，学习发生在灰质增大之前。
这种收获似乎也伴随着某种取舍：在一项回忆复杂图形的测试中，通过考试的司机表现不如未参训者。研究的样本群体较小，而且全部为男性，但结果仍提示，健康的成人大脑可以通过高强度学习重塑自身。看来，每记住一条街道，都像是占用了原先属于其他事物的一点空间。

illustration_prompt:
Create a single publication-quality landscape 3:2 narrative illustration for an adult illustrated English-reading booklet. Finished standalone artwork, not a book mockup, not a collage of multiple unrelated panels. Sophisticated contemporary editorial gouache and watercolor, carefully controlled colored-pencil accents, velvety matte paint, subtle warm paper texture, soft natural daylight. Warm ivory paper dominates; subdued eucalyptus and sage greens structure the composition; restrained buttery lemon-yellow and dusty terracotta accents. Calm, comfortable, refined, credible drawing and natural anatomy. An airy coherent composition with one clear story focal point and at most two supporting details, generous breathing room at all edges and softly feathered painted edges into ivory. Detailed but uncluttered. Historically and scientifically appropriate objects, clothing and setting. Show the particular article's pivotal event or mechanism rather than a generic portrait or generic textbook symbols. Human figures treated with dignity; no grotesque caricature, no sensational violence or visible injuries. For disasters, emphasize the setting, evidence or human response without graphic suffering. For uncertain scientific claims, depict the observations and investigation without presenting debated mechanisms as proven. Absolutely no typography, captions, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, diagram labels, fake writing or invented charts anywhere. Do not render invisible forces as literal magic. Avoid corporate vector icons, slick 3D rendering and childish cartoon style. High-quality, print-ready visual storytelling, matching a warm ivory-and-sage adult watercolor booklet.

ARTICLE 04 — The Brain That Learned London. Show a London taxi-driver trainee in his thirties studying at a simple wooden table by a window, tracing a route with one index finger on a large unfolded paper street plan. His other hand rests naturally on the page; an intent but relaxed adult expression. A traditional black London taxi is visible parked on an ordinary London street beyond the window, softly out of focus, and plain terraced buildings establish the location. The map has only faint unlabeled street lines and a subtle river curve, absolutely no names, lettering, numerals, compass text or invented data. This is an ordinary scene of intensive route learning, not an illustration claiming that learning has conclusively caused brain growth. Do not show a giant brain, glowing neural pathways, before-and-after brains, arrows or a fake MRI chart. Natural anatomy, credible hands, contemporary early-2000s clothing, warm ivory desk and paper, restrained sage-green room and dusty terracotta accents. One coherent airy landscape 3:2 illustration, generous edge space, soft daylight and softly feathered paint into ivory.

海马体参与记忆与认路；司机的海马体后部比对照男性大、前部小，最初无法判断原因。
与经验、压力相近但走固定路线的公交司机相比，出租车司机的海马体后部灰质仍更多。
学员与对照者起初脑部相似；三四年后，仅考过者海马体后部灰质增加，支持成人大脑可随学习改变。
样本小且全为男性；考过者在一项图形记忆测试中比未参训者差，提示认路能力增强可能伴随记忆取舍。
